done_when: forge close skips the test run, as it does for docs-only changes, when the change touches only forge.toml, docs, plans, Markdown or Forge's records, and says so in one line naming the command it did not run. A command-level test closes a forge.toml-only change without running the test command.
why: A change that only edits forge.toml still waits for and runs the whole test suite at close, though it changes no code; CI runs the suite anyway
